name: environment
script: set -e; cat /etc/os-release; python3 --version; g++ --version; dpkg-query -W ros-jazzy-rclcpp ros-jazzy-rclcpp-action ros-jazzy-rclpy ros-jazzy-std-msgs ros-jazzy-action-msgs ros-jazzy-rcl-interfaces ros-jazzy-rmw-fastrtps-cpp python3-colcon-core; git -C /candidate rev-parse HEAD; git -C /driver_ws/src/aubo_ros2_driver rev-parse HEAD; python3 -c "from rclpy.qos import ReliabilityPolicy,DurabilityPolicy,HistoryPolicy; print({c.__name__:{v.name:int(v) for v in c} for c in [ReliabilityPolicy,DurabilityPolicy,HistoryPolicy]})"
argv: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /candidate-install/setup.bash; if [ -f /integration-install/setup.bash ]; then source /integration-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=161 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/integration-evidence/roslogs; set -e; cat /etc/os-release; python3 --version; g++ --version; dpkg-query -W ros-jazzy-rclcpp ros-jazzy-rclcpp-action ros-jazzy-rclpy ros-jazzy-std-msgs ros-jazzy-action-msgs ros-jazzy-rcl-interfaces ros-jazzy-rmw-fastrtps-cpp python3-colcon-core; git -C /candidate rev-parse HEAD; git -C /driver_ws/src/aubo_ros2_driver rev-parse HEAD; python3 -c "from rclpy.qos import ReliabilityPolicy,DurabilityPolicy,HistoryPolicy; print({c.__name__:{v.name:int(v) for v in c} for c in [ReliabilityPolicy,DurabilityPolicy,HistoryPolicy]})"
